rows.details: SUK Research and Development Foundation (SUKRDF), Section 8 Company of Shivaji University, Kolhapur
Maximum CTC up to ₹ 50,000/- fixed and consolidated, per month

content_sections.heading: About SUKRDF
content_sections.text: SUK Research and Development Foundation (SUKRDF) is a Section 8 Company of Shivaji University, Kolhapur. The post advertised is an Administrative post in the Foundation. The notice is signed by the CEO, SUKRDF, at Kolhapur and dated 13.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Post graduate preferably from Management discipline. Experience, as printed in the notice, any of the following (listed with "/" between them): Experience as Executive Director / Centre Manager of minimum 2 years of successful Incubation Centre Academic teaching experience of minimum 2 years Experience of managing legal compliance of admission to graduation of min 5 successful incubates Minimum 3 years of experience with industrial organization of managing team members Experience of preparing incubation policy document, knowledge of start-up support system, experience of networking with industry & mentors Experience of filing and documentation of Centre operations Knowledge of ISO system of certification, Planning, operation and scaling up of mentoring clinic kind of activities Age limit: Above 30 years. Proficiency in Marathi and English languages is essential. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is purely on contract basis and will be offered for a period of 11 months. Compensation is maximum CTC up to ₹ 50,000/- fixed and consolidated, per month. This is the maximum possible CTC, and the final offer may differ, subject to the approval of SUKRDF and University Authorities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SUKRDF Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form online on the Shivaji University website www.unishivaji.ac.in under the tab "Recruitments", or through the Google form link given in the notice, on or before 20/11/2026. Bring two (02) hard copies of the application form to the interview. Attach attested copies of all relevant necessary documents to one of the two copies. Applicants already employed in temporary or permanent capacity in the University, affiliated colleges or government agencies outside the University must submit their applications through proper channel on or before the last date. Candidates who do not comply with these instructions are considered Not Eligible for the further selection process. For any query, the notice gives the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process shall be undertaken through rigorous interview. The date of the walk-in interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates. The interview will be conducted at the Main Administrative Building, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, with a reporting time of 10:30 AM. SUKRDF reserves all rights to decide the criteria and procedure for shortlisting eligible candidates. Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not confer any right to be called for interview or for final selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many Incubation Manager posts are vacant at SUKRDF?
faq.answer: One post is vacant, in the Open category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SUKRDF Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online on or before 20/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for SUKRDF Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: Post graduate preferably from Management discipline, with experience as listed in the notice, such as 2 years as Executive Director / Centre Manager of a successful Incubation Centre or 2 years of academic teaching.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is Above 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the SUKRDF Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: Maximum CTC up to ₹ 50,000/- fixed and consolidated, per month. The final offer may differ, subject to approval of SUKRDF and University Authorities.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed form on www.unishivaji.ac.in under the tab "Recruitments" by 20/11/2026, then bring two hard copies of the form to the interview, one with attested copies of all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through rigorous interview. The interview date will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract basis for a period of 11 months.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the interview held and when should I report?
faq.answer: The interview is at the Main Administrative Building, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, with a reporting time of 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Is knowledge of any language required?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency in Marathi and English languages is essential.
